traits.name: whimsy
traits.reason: Lines are full of playful reversals and absurd fine print (edible rules, sand as patient fudge, a storehouse with ambitions). Item renaming is only partial: fud

traits.name: secrecy
traits.reason: Coordinates are stated openly and repeatedly, and 'five riddles' is mentioned without any riddle or whispered faction name. No secrecy is shown.

traits.name: tests honesty
traits.reason: No goals with honesty details, no confirmations of completed goals, and no prizes weighted by kept promises. The only hint is a mention of rules.

traits.name: mercurial
traits.reason: Gentle openings and a dry deadpan landing recur, but the manic register is mostly missing and the lines are repetitive and fairly uniform in tone.

traits.name: generosity
traits.reason: Only invitations to come see the empty sand. No escrowed rewards, tours, or gifts appear, and the actions are just gathering and walking.
